description: Categorises a stencil's background into a native SVG primitive that the unified-SVG canvas () can render as an <rect>, <ellipse>, <polygon> or <path> directly inside the node <g>. Stencils whose background cannot be cleanly expressed as a single SVG primitive (e.g. cylinder, cloud, actor, sticky-note, cube, complex component/package outlines …) map to . For those the canvas keeps the existing HTML/CSS fallback (inside the node's <foreignObject>) and does not emit a native SVG primitive.
